name: Raymond Sommer
features: fair skin, dark hair neatly parted, alert dark eyes, handsome regular features, athletic build, cheerful fearless expression
bio: 'Coeur de Lion' — the Lionheart. Raymond Sommer won Le Mans in 1932 and 1933, the second time driving over 20 hours almost single-handed after his co-driver fell ill. A privateer by choice who turned down works contracts to keep his independence, he led at Le Mans every year until 1938 without finishing again.
